# oblique_admin (Resource)

Admins are the set of users responsible for managing Oblique. They have special permissions to own API objects that aren't explicitly owned by another user, team, or group. They are also responsible for system settings like integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant admin privileges to a user. Admins have elevated permissions across
# the Oblique instance and can manage system-wide settings like integrations.
data "oblique_user" "janedoe" {
  email = "janedoe@example.com"
}
resource "oblique_admin" "janedoe" {
  user = data.oblique_user.janedoe.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) The user that has been granted admin privileges.

Format: `users/{user}`

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the admin resource. This is an arbitrary string and does not have to match the user's name.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) The time the admin was created.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `management` (Attributes) How this admin is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the calling client. Omitted from responses when the admin is manually managed (the default). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management))
- `update_time` (String) The time the admin was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management`

Read-Only:

- `manager` (String) How the resource is managed. Set automatically by the server based on the caller: Terraform clients produce TERRAFORM; for all other clients the management field is left unset on the response.
- `repo_dir` (String) Optionally, the subdirectory within `repo_uri` that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
- `repo_uri` (String) URI of the VCS repository that holds the Terraform configuration for this resource. Populated by the Oblique Terraform provider.
